measured_absence.found: nothing — MUC/Hosting is a target rather than a client present on this node

note: MUC/Hosting is a designed long-term Steward entry point, not a client with historical use behind it. The design document says as much; that is exactly why its status has to be a measurement rather than an assumption, and why nothing here is written as supported.

unblock.then: run the same contract as the other clients, plus the two things this entry point specifically claims: policy decision and notification pull
unblock.what_must_not_be_done_instead: recording the fields from the design document. The design says what is intended, not what has run

write_flow_verified.unblock: a connected session that can really invoke a write use case, through admission

durable_job_disconnect_verified.unblock: a connected session that can be disconnected while a durable job runs
